acceptance_criteria.criterion: The 11 pure-mechanical rows are closed with their merge commit named as evidence.
The 4 PR-body prose acts are collapsed into ONE sweep row rather than four slices, and it is verified that GitHub still permits editing a merged PR's body in this repo.

dr-w26-s6's merge criterion is restated to the code-scoped grep (`git grep -l publish_clock origin/main -- cloud/lib internal api/lib cloud/priv` exits 1) - the unscoped grep can never be empty because the charter, two ledgers and two census tests must NAME the term they forbid.

content.description: 26 of 98 open rows have their doc_id printed in an origin/main commit message; all 26 have a real merge commit, and 18 sit at N-1 of N criteria - the shipped-and-merged-but-never-closed shape. Zero open rows are at full criteria, so criteria progress ALONE does not detect this class; only the commit cross-reference does. The honest partition: 11 PURE MECHANICAL (sole unmet criterion is a bare merge gate) - dr-w18-s1, dr-w19-s3, dr-w19-s4, dr-w19-s5, dr-w20-s1, dr-w20-s4, dr-w22-s4, dr-w23-s5, dr-w25-s1, dr-w25-s4, dr-w25-s5. 2 MECHANICAL PLUS ONE SMALL ACT (dr-w22-s1 also closes #10019 as superseded; dr-w22-s2 quotes the interpolated Elixir gate job name). 5 COMPOUND MERGE needing one live re-read (dr-w21-s2, dr-w21-s6 whose BEFORE reading can no longer be taken, dr-w22-s3, dr-w24-s2 which is blocked on the operator's stale bp binary, dr-w26-s6 whose criterion is unsatisfiable as written). 8 GENUINE - of which FOUR are 'the PR BODY states X' on an already-merged PR, i.e. prose acts belonging in ONE sweep row, not eight slices. Only dr-w24-followup-diverged-is-not-ranked is unbuilt work, and it is blocked on a charter decision about whether commit_ancestry diverged ranks. 'Twenty-six rows of headroom' is honest for about 18.
